policy.promotion: Optimization score must be strictly below the last accepted optimization score. Holdout never vetoes, selects or retunes a candidate.
policy.failed_run: Optimization score fails to strictly improve the last accepted optimization score.
policy.comparison_threshold: Strict optimization improvement; no post-hoc tolerance or observation exclusions.
policy.scope: Performance selection only; correctness and frozen-source qualification remain prerequisites. Both complete aggregate sets are reported.
policy.holdout_use: Report aggregate generalization and the below1.0x C goal separately; no promotion/rollback decision, per-case diagnosis, tuning or candidate retry based on holdout.
policy.controls: Report raw Mech runtime, original-reference drift and C drift separately; selection uses the fixed optimization Mech/C score.
policy.historical_decisions: Retain the original two-set decisions through history46. An explicit user-directed amendment accepts round47 and applies optimization-only promotion from47 onward.
